name: hl-imgui
description: Haxe/HashLink bindings for Dear ImGui, backed by imgui.hdll
releasenote: Add a bundled Latin/Greek/Cyrillic font (with an optional CJK fallback a player can drop in), Tab-driven input-text completion, ImGuiListClipper bindings, and several printf-style text widgets (bulletText, textColored, textWrapped, ...); a crashing mod panel no longer takes down ImGui rendering for every other mod.
